environment: Windows x64; synthetic repository and local SQLite

observed: A downloaded review with a stable user ID offered the action. A review with the same login and no stable ID did not.
The preview identified user 72, the fixture repository and the review and inline-comment scope. Dismissal left the policy unchanged.
Confirmation stored one repository rule and left the account-wide rules empty. Both downloaded review records matched their original values.
Activity identified user and GitHub App review actors. Ordinary comments and unidentified reviews had no contextual review actor.
A later review by the muted actor was suppressed. Earlier activity, ordinary comments, and another reviewer's activity remained. A different account could not read the rule.
